latest.title: How We Made AWS Control Tower (CfCT) Deployments Fail Loud Instead of Silent
latest.description: Our CI/CD pipeline turned green. The CfCT deployment had "succeeded." Two weeks later, during a security review, we found that several accounts had been missing a critical baseline configuration the whole time. The pipeline wasn't lying — it just wasn't watching. This post walks through how we wrapped Customizations for AWS Control Tower (CfCT) with pre-deploy checks and post-deploy verification to close the feedback gap.

latest.title: Building a Privacy-First CloudOps Triage Agent with Strands SDK and Ollama
latest.description: I built ARIA, a stateful AI triage agent that runs 100% on your laptop using Strands Agents SDK and Ollama's phi3.5, no API keys, no data leaving your machine. In this walkthrough, I'll show you how deliberate prompt engineering with XML tags, the DARA incident framework, and Strands' conversation management turns a 3.8B local model into a production-grade war-room assistant.

latest.title: O maior erro de quem começa em Cloud Computing (e como eu destravei meus estudos em AWS)
latest.description:
Quando comecei a estudar Cloud Computing, achei que precisava aprender todos os serviços da AWS para conseguir criar projetos reais. O problema é que isso só me deixava mais perdido.

Neste artigo, compartilho os erros que mais atrasaram meu aprendizado, como comecei a evoluir através de projetos práticos e por que participar da comunidade mudou completamente minha visão sobre tecnologia e carreira.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
